verdict.rationale: Numeral's own marketing and pricing pages claim it registers, files, and remits across US and global jurisdictions "on time, every time" with Autofile. It also guarantees to pay penalties and interest if a filing is late, and the docs say recorded transactions feed into return filing. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the filing and remittance workflow (cadence, how review approvals work, how funds are debited), the guarantee's terms and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late
